profile.name: The Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL)
profile.what: India's largest hotel company: 382 operating hotels and 33,609 keys at 30-Jun-2026 (134 owned/leased hotels with 13,355 keys, 20 JV/associate hotels with 1,723 keys, 228 managed or franchised hotels with 18,531 keys), plus 263 hotels (~32,500 keys) in the pipeline, 81% of it managed. Brands: Taj (93 hotels), Claridges Collection, Vivanta, SeleQtions, Gateway, Ginger (166), Tree of Life, Atmantan, Brij, ama (382 bungalows) and Qmin (food). Also 51% of TajSATS, India's largest airline caterer.
profile.segments: Two reported segments: Hotels (FY26 operating revenue Rs8,487 cr, operating EBITDA Rs2,907 cr) and Air catering (TajSATS, consolidated from 1-Aug-2024: Rs1,210 cr / Rs287 cr).

portfolio.q1Openings: 11 hotels / 700 keys opened in Q1FY27 (incl. the leased Taj Hessischer Hof, Frankfurt, 126 keys); 20 signed. 14 hotels / 1,200+ keys expected in Q2. FY27 guide: 60+ openings, ~800 leased keys and ~4,200 managed keys.

accounting.exceptionalEveryYear: Exceptional items in each of the last five years (FY22 +48, FY23 +64, FY24 +24, FY25 +345, FY26 +309 on Screener; company FY26 net +236 after tax). FY25-26 gains are one-off (TajSATS fair-value, Taj GVK sale) but recurring smaller charges (key money, labour codes, contingencies) also sit below the line.
accounting.leases: Ind AS 116: lease liabilities Rs2,786 cr (Mar-26), right-of-use assets Rs2,287 cr; rent is below EBITDA (interest + depreciation), so EBITDA flatters leased hotels versus owned ones. License fees (revenue-share leases) stay in opex (Rs385 cr in FY26 hotel segment).
accounting.goodwill: Goodwill rose to Rs1,121 cr (Mar-26) from Rs711 cr after ANK/Pride and Atmantan.
accounting.airportLevy: TajSATS revenue now includes an airport levy passed through, which lowers its reported margin (~1-2.3 pp).
